'''Povanarians''' were a [[Frog/Legends|frog]]-like [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Povanaria]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> They were one of the member species of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], serving alongside [[Bagmim]]s and [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]].<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
